mapper.select: SELECT m.* FROM chat_message m INNER JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END AS partner_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM chat_message WHERE sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId} GROUP BY partner_id) t ON m.id = t.max_id ORDER BY m.id DESC
SELECT sender_id AS senderId, COUNT(*) AS unread FROM chat_message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND read_status = 0 GROUP BY sender_id
